parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: Pipeline ID, which can be obtained from the pipeline link, for example: https://flow.aliyun.com/pipelines/【PipelineId】/current

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status: FAIL indicates failed, SUCCESS indicates succeeded, RUNNING indicates running

parameters.name: triggerMode
parameters.description:
- Trigger mode

  1 Manual trigger
   
  2 Scheduled trigger 

  3 Code submission trigger
 
  5 Pipeline trigger

  6 WEBHOOK trigger
